label: Machine time from CPH
subgoals: Multiply placements per board by the build quantity
Divide by the sustained CPH for the job
Add setup time that scales with BOM lines

label: Balancing a placement line
subgoals: Compute each machine's time per board
Take the slowest machine as the cycle time
Move placements between machines to balance the line

label: Centroid data and rotations
subgoals: Reference positions to the footprint's center origin
Apply the package rotation offset modulo 360
